comments.body:
Hey everyone! We're OP Stack core devs who want to help accelerate PeerDAS. We've been asking core devs what we can help with & heard that spinning up devnets at a large blob count could be useful, so we're working on it. Here's the current status:

- We spun up a devnet with pectra & set up monitors for baseline metrics (will do the same for current fusaka code with lighthouse this week).
- Running a fuzzer that incrementally sends two more blobs every 10min until 72.
- Will share the grafana dashboard after it all finishes.

I'm curious what you think about this. In the call, please let us know which metrics you want to see and, if any, which scenarios you want to reproduce for research!

Call today (Mar 4) has been cancelled, as client teams are either focused on Holesky recovery or unavailable. Will move the call to next week (10am UTC). 

Thanks @taempark for the agenda topic - feel free to start async discussion on #peerdas-testing R&D, or we can talk about it in the next call!

I've been thinking about mining some of the node keys so that we can control a bit the distribution of columns on our devnets. This would reduce the amount of servers required. Specially useful also for local testing on kurtosis.

This would require that we can set the nodekey on every client, either via a CLI flag, or a file.

Thanks for joining the call today!  

## Summary:
- CL teams are continuing to make progress on various fixes and validator custody, with some help from external teams (Base) :hammer:  
- Gajinder proposed a spec change to simplify validator custody, and teams should review and provide feedback ASAP. :eyes:  
- We had some EL representatives on the call to discuss spec changes. :fire:  
- Geth, Nethermind, and EthereumJS will participate in devnet-6. :rocket:  
- **Teams should review the network wrapper change and aim to finalize it in the next 2 days** so that all CL/EL teams can start implementation.:person_running:
- Devnet-5 is running well with full nodes; CL teams should verify that the nodes are indeed set up as full nodes.  
- ethPandaOps will start introducing some chaos into devnet-5.
- Francis from Base created a roadmap document (to replace the readiness checklist). Please review and help update it: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MXf5zTU58mRj0Yq88EPBP1gCJzWTY9FRfUdpZjcfgqw/edit?tab=t.0  
- **The next breakout call will be on Tuesday at 1400 UTC!**
